safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that there were no signs of cellulitis can lead to ambiguity about whether a skin infection was considered/excluded, potentially prompting unnecessary follow-up, monitoring, or antibiotic expectations. However, this does not directly change immediate management of the acute allergic reaction concern and is unlikely to cause significant harm on its own.
